question:
Select the term from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the given series to make it logically complete.

DT 35, EU 33, ?, GW 29, HX 27
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First and second letter → (1) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Number → (2) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0621578bb461dd83e2d2cd5a88538c664ccc0ce395e765cf9d16ca2b15411b09.png] 

​Hence, "**FV 31**" is the correct answer.
